experiment_data.hypothesis: Full-SGS: detach all non-KL gradients from dt_emb (removes 93% obs decoder contribution). If CIVO persists → vulnerability is representation-level; if eliminated → obs decoder gradient is root cause.
experiment_data.notes: Full-SGS completely eliminates CIVO. NVE never exceeds 0.72x (threshold=1.5x). eval_return climbs monotonically to 915.7 (vs baseline 600-750). Value function consistently UNDERESTIMATES actual performance — opposite of CIVO. This proves obs decoder gradients flowing through dt_emb are the ROOT CAUSE of CIVO (gradient-level vulnerability, not representation-level). Comparison: 016e (reward-only SGS) NVE=10.42x (CIVO present because reward grad≈0), 008d (no SGS) NVE=4.12x (CIVO+collapse), 018 (full SGS) NVE=0.72x max (no CIVO, strong performance).
